Selecting "Deadline" reorders list ascending: Tomorrow, Sep 4, Sep 7, Sep 9, Sep 16.

Successfully edited (title/description/priority), completed (checkbox toggled, moved to Completed tab), and deleted ("Organize desk" removed with toast "Task deleted" and count updated) a task.

"QA Dependency Task", "Complete tax filing", and "Submit final report" all show disabled (grayed) Complete and Edit buttons since their prerequisite tasks are not completed.
Tasks with incomplete prerequisites show a label: "Prerequisite \"X\" incomplete" (single) or "N prerequisites incomplete" (multiple), indicating dependency not completed.
Hovering over the "2 prerequisites incomplete" label on QA Dependency Task triggers a tooltip titled "Dependency Chain" listing "Buy groceries - pending" and "Schedule dentist appointment - pending".
Hovering over the dependency/prerequisite label reveals a visible "Dependency Chain" popup listing each prerequisite task with its status (pending), providing clear visual feedback.

Complete button (checkbox) for "QA Dependency Task", "Complete tax filing", and "Submit final report" is rendered with the disabled attribute while their prerequisites are incomplete, preventing marking them complete.

"QA Dependency Task" depends on "Buy groceries". Opening Edit dialog for "Buy groceries" shows the Prerequisites checklist excludes "QA Dependency Task" entirely, preventing selection of a task that would create a circular dependency.

"Create Task" button remains disabled (disabled=true) whenever the Title field is empty, both on initial dialog open and after clearing a previously entered title via keyboard; task cannot be submitted.
When Title is empty, "Create Task" button is rendered disabled with class "disabled:opacity-50", visually dimming/graying it out to indicate the form cannot be submitted without a title.

issue: Past deadline dates are accepted when creating a task
actual: Created a task titled "Past Date Test" with deadline 2020-01-01 (a date far in the past relative to today 2026-09-02). The Create Task button remained enabled and the task was created successfully, displayed with an "Overdue: Jan 1" label instead of being blocked. No validation error prevented past-dated task creation.

evidence: Deadline field is a native HTML date input (type="date") with a calendar picker button. Valid dates like "2026-09-10" are accepted and displayed correctly (e.g. "Sep 10"); attempting to set an invalid string ("invalid-date") directly is rejected by the browser and the field remains empty, enforcing correct date format.

Each task card on the main page displays the title (heading), due date (e.g. "Sep 10", "Tomorrow", "Overdue: Jan 1"), and completion status via a checkbox-style button: unchecked/empty circle for active tasks vs. filled circle with a checkmark icon (lucide-check) for completed tasks.
